This seems to convert a nitro group to amine? It shows product with NH2 attached to aromatic ring and still a nitro group elsewhere. Might be a reduction of one nitro to amine.

Third entry reaction_id 57317 mapped_rxn: similar.

We need a template that reduces nitro to amine (primary amine). The simplest is probably reaction_id 2687 where product_smiles is '[NH2:1][c:2]1...'. That seems appropriate.

Probably template_id corresponds to reaction_id. We'll use reaction_id.

Thus choose template with reaction_id 2687. Need mapped_rxn string. It's given as 'NC1=C(O)C([N+](=O)[O-])=CC([N+:6](=[O:7])[O-:8])=C1.CO[C:10]1=[C:2]([NH2:1])[CH:3]=[CH:4][CH:5]=[CH:9]1>>[NH2:1][C:2]1=[CH:3][CH:4]=[C:5]([N+:6](=[O:7])[O-:8])[CH:9]=[CH:10]1'. That's the mapped reaction.
